pages.text: The $(item)Soul Chestplate$() is the core of the soul armor set. Dealing damage by any means accumulates soul energy in the chestplate.$(br2)Once you have enough soul energy, press the $(thing)Soul Rage$() key ($(thing)V$() by default) to activate a powerful empowered state. While active, you gain massive damage reduction and heal a portion of the damage you deal.$(br2)Soul Rage cannot be manually deactivated — it drains soul energy over time until it runs out.

pages.title: Warden Interaction
pages.text: While wearing the Soul Chestplate, the Warden's sonic attack will not damage you. Instead, it will grant you a burst of soul energy.
